title: Content Item Text Content Fields
description: Textual content and content types fields of media content items in the Impresso project.

doc_type_s.description: Type of document, e.g., page (p) or content item (ci).

segmentation_level_s.title: Segmentation level
segmentation_level_s.description: Level of segmentation applied to the source facsimile from which the content item is derived.

oneOf.title: No Segmentation (Page or Broadcast)
oneOf.description: No optical layout segmentation applied; the content item corresponds to a full page or broadcast unit.

oneOf.title: Physical Segmentation (Layout regions)
oneOf.description: Physical layout segmentation into regions such as images, columns, or paragraphs.

oneOf.title: Logical Segmentation (Articles and editorial units)
oneOf.description: Logical segmentation into articles and other editorial or structural units.

oneOf.title: Semantic Segmentation (Thematic units)
oneOf.description: Semantic segmentation into thematically or conceptually coherent units.

oneOf.title: Article
oneOf.description: Editorial article forming a coherent textual unit.

oneOf.title: Image
oneOf.description: Standalone visual content such as a photograph, illustration, or graphic.

oneOf.title: Table
oneOf.description: Tabular content presenting structured data or listings.

oneOf.title: Obituary
oneOf.description: Notice reporting a death, often including biographical information.

oneOf.title: Chronicle
oneOf.description: Broadcast chronicle reporting events in a factual or narrative form.

oneOf.title: Radio Broadcast
oneOf.description: Content item originating from a radio broadcast.

oneOf.title: Radio Broadcast Episode
oneOf.description: An individual episode or segment of a radio broadcast.

oneOf.title: No Type Provided
oneOf.description: Content item with no specific type provided.

oneOf.title: Discussion
oneOf.description: Radio Broadcast discussion or talk show content item.

lg_orig_s.description: Original language of the content item.

lg_s.description: Computed language of the content item.

content_length_i.description: Token count of the content item (space split).

snippet_plain.description: Snippet of the content item (first 150 characters).

title_txt.description: Fallback title field when no language-specific title field is available.

content_txt.description: Fallback content field when no language-specific content field is available.

title_year.description: String composed of title + year, e.g. 'Fronde-1872' .

^title_txt_[a-z]{2}$.description: Title of the article in the specified language (ISO 639-1 two-letter language code)

^content_txt_[a-z]{2}$.description: Full text content of the article in the specified language (ISO 639-1 two-letter language code)
